about: Regression cases where release_title deliberately answers differently from the old parser, with the reason.

cases.title: Show [BD]
cases.reason: [BD] alone is not a batch keyword: single BD episodes carry it too. Only the torznab detector ever used it.

cases.title: [ANBU-AonE]_SeriesTitle_26-27_[F224EF26].avi
cases.reason: A title naming one video file is a multi-episode file, not a batch pack.

cases.title: [Group]_Dark_Gathering_S2_05_[1080p]
cases.reason: A season marker followed by a bare episode is season 2 episode 5, read structurally (the #296 stopgap returned nothing).
